attempts.content: {"elements":[{"id":"e1","risk":"safe","reason":"Email is standard contact data entry for the quote; reversible with no external effect until quote is requested."},{"id":"e2","risk":"safe","reason":"Optional phone number is just contact info; reversible data entry with no commitment."},{"id":"e3","risk":"safe","reason":"Title selection is a reversible personal detail with no effect outside the session."},{"id":"e4","risk":"safe","reason":"First name entry is basic personal data; reversible and expected for driver details."},{"id":"e5","risk":"safe","reason":"Surname entry is basic personal data; reversible and expected for driver details."},{"id":"e6","risk":"safe","reason":"Date of birth is required for insurance rating; reversible data entry, not a legal declaration or ID submission itself."},{"id":"e7","risk":"safe","reason":"Postcode is address data for rating; reversible entry with no commitment."},{"id":"e8","risk":"safe","reason":"House number and street is address data for rating; reversible entry with no commitment."},{"id":"e9","risk":"safe","reason":"Main occupation is a rating factor; choosing from list is reversible with no external effect."},{"id":"e10","risk":"safe","reason":"Employment status is a rating factor; radio selection is reversible."},{"id":"e11","risk":"safe","reason":"Claims history question is factual underwriting info; Yes/No selection is reversible and does not itself commit legally."},{"id":"e12","risk":"safe","reason":"Date of claim is detail of prior claim; reversible date entry with no external effect."},{"id":"e13","risk":"safe","reason":"Type of claim is detail of prior claim; reversible selection with no external effect."},{"id":"e14","risk":"safe","reason":"'Next' only navigates to next step of quote flow; reversible and does not finalize or request the quote."}]}
